intent: One toast that follows one async job. It opens on loading with a hairline sweeping its lower edge, morphs in place to success or error, and on success counts its window down, with Undo and a ring around the button when Undo is on. Hover or focus pauses the countdown, a swipe or Esc dismisses it, error offers Retry when wired, the copy is announced politely, and onStatusChange reports each change of the current run so the host can mirror the outcome.

stack.animation: motion/react (useMotionValue and useTransform for the countdown ring and swipe offset, animate for the countdown and spring back, AnimatePresence with popLayout for the status glyph and copy, a variant set with custom direction for the exit, useInView for the demo entrance)

layout.card: at most 392px wide (fills a narrower container), radius 14px, padding 14px 16px 16px; one grid with a 12px column gap. From 448px of container (@md): one row of 18px status glyph, text column (minmax(0,1fr)), the action (Undo 76 x 32px pill or Try again), and a 28px dismiss centred on the pill. Below 448px: glyph, copy and dismiss on the first row (dismiss centred on the title line), the action on a second row under the copy, 12px below and left-aligned with it
layout.placement: a @container layer fills the nearest positioned parent (absolute by default) or the viewport (fixed); the card sits bottom-right, bottom-center or top-right inside a padding of 16px, or 24px once the container is 448px or wider (@md:); no viewport breakpoints
layout.ring: rounded rect 84.5 x 40.5 radius 20.25 drawn 5px outside the Undo button in an 86 x 42 svg; dash length equals the perimeter (2*pi*20.25 + 2*(84.5 - 40.5) = 215.2) and the dash offset is (1 - remaining) * length
layout.hitAreas: Undo's pill is 32px tall with a 44px hit area (::before); the dismiss circle is 28px with a 44px hit area; the Retry text button has a 44px hit area
layout.hairline: 2px tall along the card's lower edge, clipped by the card's radius; loading sweep 40% wide, success and error bars scale from the left edge
layout.demo: 560px column: a stage card with 440px minimum height, header with 'Inbox' and a mono count, a toolbar with a Snooze 5 threads button beside the Archive 12 threads pill (under @md the buttons take the full width as two equal columns, one per row below 320px of stage), five thread rows with 32px monograms; the stage reserves 128px at the bottom for a bottom toast or at the top for a top-right toast, 176px under @md where the action stacks. No toast until a click or a control change, and no footer hint
layout.actionRow: the action slot opens and closes with a grid-template-rows transition from 0fr to 1fr (300ms, ease-out), so the narrow card grows and shrinks rather than jumping; the card's overflow clips the button while the row opens

typography.title: Geist (font-sans) 500, 14px / 20px, tracking -0.01em, text-wrap: balance
typography.description: Geist 400, 13px / 1.45, tabular-nums, text-wrap: pretty; the window ('· 5 s to undo') is its own nowrap span after a plain space, so a wrap lands before the dot
typography.labels: 13px 500 for Undo, Try again and the demo's buttons (dismiss is icon-only)
typography.demoMeta: mono 11px tabular-nums for counts and times

color.approach: monochrome first: ink and muted greys carry all the copy and controls; success (#6fd08c dark, #3f8a50 light) and error (#ff7a6b dark, #c9553d light) are the only hues and appear only on the glyph and the settled hairline
color.dark: card #17171a; hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.09); ink #f4f4f5; muted #a1a1aa; undo fill rgba(255,255,255,0.06) with hover 0.12; shadow 0 28px 56px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) plus 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
color.light: card #ffffff; hairline rgba(24,24,27,0.09); ink #18181b; muted #52525b; undo fill rgba(24,24,27,0.05) with hover 0.09
color.demo: dark stage #000 with a #0b0b0c card and a 0 40px 80px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.9) shadow; light stage #f4f4f5 with a white card and a softer 0 32px 64px -32px rgba(24,24,27,0.12) shadow; the stage follows the theme control

motion.entrance: card rises 14px from opacity 0 with a 6px blur that clears over 420ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.statusSwap: copy and glyph cross-fade with a 6px rise, 3px blur, 260ms; outgoing copy 160ms ease-in; no hard cut
motion.glyphs: spinner: 18px ring with a 90-degree arc, one turn per 1.2s; success check draws its stroke over 340ms after an 80ms delay; error is a circle with a cross
motion.sweep: loading hairline sweep: 40% wide soft gradient moving left to right every 1.3s, linear, repeating; animated as a transform (x from -100% to 250% of its own width), never left
motion.resolve: success or error hairline scales from its left edge over 500ms; the success bar fades 1.1s later
motion.countdown: a motion value runs linearly 1 to 0 over the success window whether or not Undo is on; hover, focus or a hidden tab pauses it in place and resume continues from the same point; empty means the toast leaves and onDismiss runs; the ring is drawn only when Undo is on
motion.undo: Undo appears with a 220ms scale from 0.92 and opacity; pressing it swaps the glyph to a return arrow, restores the copy and leaves after 1.6s
motion.retry: on error with onRetry set, a quiet text button fades in 4px upward, muted at rest and ink on hover; pressing it calls onRetry and runs the job again from loading
motion.swipe: horizontal drag with a 0.35 rubber band from the first pixel (zero drag constraints); past 90px or faster than 500px/s it dismisses in the drag direction (420px fly and fade); otherwise a spring back (stiffness 420, damping 36); touch-action pan-y
motion.exit: dismiss drops 8px and fades over 220ms on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
motion.reducedMotion: no rise, blur, fly, spin or sweep; the loading hairline becomes a faint full-width track; opacity changes over 150ms; the countdown still drains because it reports time
motion.actionRow: narrow layout only in effect: the action row eases open and closed via grid-template-rows (300ms), no transition under reduced motion

responsive.widths: designed at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px: the card fills a narrow container and is 392px at most; under 448px of container the action stacks on its own row so title and description keep the card's width; the layer's inset follows its container width
responsive.overflow: no horizontal scroll at any width; the description wraps to two lines at most
responsive.touch: Undo 32px visible and 44px to hit, dismiss 28px visible and 44px to hit; the card is the swipe surface; no hover-only controls

accessibility: a visually hidden role=status with aria-live=polite lives in the always-mounted layer, starts empty and receives 'title. description' on the next frame after each status change; the countdown never announces
the card is a div with role=group and aria-labelledby pointing at its title (not a landmark; the live region announces)
Undo moves focus to the Dismiss button, so focus survives Undo unmounting
hover and focus are cleared when the toast leaves and read live from the DOM when the next one opens, so a stale flag never freezes the countdown

Undo, Retry and dismiss are real buttons; dismiss has aria-label=Dismiss; focus rings are 2px in the current colour, shown for keyboard focus only; Undo's focus ring is drawn inside the pill (offset -3px), so the countdown ring stays the only ring around it
Escape inside the toast dismisses it
hover pauses the countdown and focus within pauses it too, so a keyboard user can read the copy and reach Undo before it leaves
reduced motion keeps opacity changes and the countdown; spinner and sweep are static
errors do not expire on a timer: they stay until retried or dismissed
contrast: ink on the card and muted copy meet WCAG AA; success and error are used on glyphs and hairlines only, never as text
onStatusChange fires only for the current run, so a host that mirrors it (fading archived rows) can never contradict the toast's own copy

content.loading: Archiving 12 threads… / Moving them out of your inbox
content.success: Archived 12 threads / Moved to Archive · 5 s to undo
content.error: Couldn’t archive 12 threads / Nothing was archived. Your inbox is unchanged.
content.undone: Restored 12 threads / Put back where it was
content.snooze: Snoozing 5 threads… / They come back to your inbox on Monday; Snoozed 5 threads / Back on Monday at 9:00 · 5 s to undo

avoid: stacking or fanning several toasts (that is toast-stack)
a spinner that never resolves or a progress bar with an invented percentage
confetti, sparkles, emoji, a tick in a rounded square, or a coloured card per state
a ticking number as the countdown: the ring is the countdown and the description states the window once
restarting the countdown on hover, or leaving it running while the pointer is on the toast
a success toast with no exit when Undo is off: the window always ends the toast
viewport breakpoints (sm:, md:) for placement: the layer responds to its container
glassmorphism, glow, gradient text, bouncing entrances, or infinite pulses on content
hard cuts between states; every change is a cross-fade or a morph
one fixed row at every width: under 448px the action stacks below the copy instead of squeezing it
raising the toast on page load: it appears on a click, as the receipt for that click
animating the loading sweep with left (layout every frame) instead of a transform
